mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM operator_role orl JOIN platform_role r ON r.id = orl.role_id WHERE orl.operator_id = #{operatorId} AND NOT r.deleted ORDER BY r.code

SELECT rp.role_id, p.code FROM platform_role r JOIN platform_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE NOT r.deleted AND p.realm = 'platform' AND p.status = 'active' AND NOT p.deleted ORDER BY p.code

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM operator_role orl JOIN platform_role r ON r.id = orl.role_id JOIN platform_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE orl.operator_id = #{operatorId} AND NOT r.deleted AND p.realm = 'platform' AND p.status = 'active' AND NOT p.deleted ORDER BY p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT #{roleId}, id FROM permission WHERE realm = 'platform' AND status = 'active' AND NOT deleted AND code IN #{code} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM platform_role_permission rp USING permission p WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.code IN #{code}
